headline: Silver Fell 4.81 Percent to 56.32 While Oil Rose 1.43 Percent
narrative: Silver fell 4.81 percent to 56.32, money leaving the precious-metals pipe. Gold fell 1.59 percent to 4,110.9 on the same pipe, while oil rose 1.43 percent to 95.49, the energy pipe taking the bid the metals gave up. Bitcoin changed hands near 82k, down 1.38 percent, the crypto pipe following the metals rather than the energy bid.
author: jordan
